description: An example pack: a subclass, a spell, a magic item, a feat and a monster, all original.

entries.name: Path of the Hearthguard
entries.desc: Your rage burns like a banked fire, warming the people you protect.

features.name: Hearth Ward
features.desc: While you're raging, allies within 10 feet of you have resistance to Cold damage.

features.name: Warm Welcome
features.desc: When you finish a Short Rest, you and up to five allies regain 1d6 extra Hit Points.

features.name: Banked Coals
features.desc: When you would drop to 0 Hit Points while raging, you can end your rage to drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Last Ember
features.desc: When your rage ends, each creature of your choice within 10 feet of you takes Fire damage equal to your Barbarian level.

entries.name: Ember Lash
entries.components: V, S, M (a pinch of ash)
entries.desc: A whip of fire cracks at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Fire damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
entries.higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

entries.name: Lantern of Steady Light
entries.desc: This brass lantern never needs oil. Wind and rain can't put it out, and its light can't be dimmed by magic of 2nd level or lower.

entries.name: Kindler
entries.desc: You can light a fire with anything that will burn, even when it's wet, as an action. When you finish a Long Rest beside a fire you lit, you gain 1 Heroic Inspiration.
